# Generated by tools/generate-firms.mjs - do not edit by hand.
# Clusters and corporations (see pe_economy_effects.txt, pe_corp_step).
# Call depths: pe_cluster_counts 3, pe_cluster_apply 3 (from pe_planet_step); pe_corp_census,
# pe_corp_dissolve, pe_corp_found, pe_corp_acquire, pe_corp_rivalry, pe_corp_branches 3
# (from pe_corp_step); pe_corp_free 4, pe_corp_msg 4; pe_corp_reset 3 (pe_command_economy);
# pe_corp_merge, pe_corp_set_war, pe_corp_fine 2 (events).

# Colony scope, quarterly: firms per main product (pe_cn_<letter>), independent firms per
# sector group (pe_ind_g<group>) and at stage 3 (pe_ind3), firms per corporation (pe_mem_<slot>).
pe_cluster_counts = {
	set_variable = { which = pe_cn_a value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_cn_c value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_cn_t value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_cn_u value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_cn_x value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_cn_y value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_cn_z value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_cn_b value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_cn_m value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_cn_e value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_cn_f value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_ind_g1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_ind_g2 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_ind_g3 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_ind_g4 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_ind3 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_mem_1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_mem_2 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_mem_3 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_mem_4 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_mem_5 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_mem_6 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_mem_7 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_mem_8 value = 0 }
	every_deposit = {
		limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms is_variable_set = pe_prim }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { is_variable_set = pe_corp } } set_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 1 } } prev = { change_variable = { which = pe_cn_a value = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 2 } } prev = { change_variable = { which = pe_cn_c value = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 3 } } prev = { change_variable = { which = pe_cn_t value = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 4 } } prev = { change_variable = { which = pe_cn_u value = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 5 } } prev = { change_variable = { which = pe_cn_x value = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 6 } } prev = { change_variable = { which = pe_cn_y value = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 7 } } prev = { change_variable = { which = pe_cn_z value = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 8 } } prev = { change_variable = { which = pe_cn_b value = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 9 } } prev = { change_variable = { which = pe_cn_m value = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 10 } } prev = { change_variable = { which = pe_cn_e value = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 11 } } prev = { change_variable = { which = pe_cn_f value = 1 } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 0 } }
			if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 2 } } } prev = { change_variable = { which = pe_ind_g1 value = 1 } } }
			else_if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 3 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 4 } } } prev = { change_variable = { which = pe_ind_g2 value = 1 } } }
			else_if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 5 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 6 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 7 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 8 } } } prev = { change_variable = { which = pe_ind_g3 value = 1 } } }
			else_if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 9 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 10 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 11 } } } prev = { change_variable = { which = pe_ind_g4 value = 1 } } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 3 } } prev = { change_variable = { which = pe_ind3 value = 1 } } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 1 } } prev = { change_variable = { which = pe_mem_1 value = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 2 } } prev = { change_variable = { which = pe_mem_2 value = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 3 } } prev = { change_variable = { which = pe_mem_3 value = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 4 } } prev = { change_variable = { which = pe_mem_4 value = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 5 } } prev = { change_variable = { which = pe_mem_5 value = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 6 } } prev = { change_variable = { which = pe_mem_6 value = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 7 } } prev = { change_variable = { which = pe_mem_7 value = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 8 } } prev = { change_variable = { which = pe_mem_8 value = 1 } } }
	}
}

# Colony scope, quarterly: the cluster modifier of each main product (level = firms - 1, at
# most 3), changed only when the level changes.

# Country scope: firms per corporation (pe_c<slot>_firms), and the cash rounded for display.
pe_corp_census = {
	set_variable = { which = pe_c1_firms value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c2_firms value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c3_firms value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c4_firms value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c5_firms value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c6_firms value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c7_firms value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c8_firms value = 0 }
	every_owned_colony = {
		limit = { is_variable_set = pe_mem_1 }
		root = {
			change_variable = { which = pe_c1_firms value = prev.pe_mem_1 }
			change_variable = { which = pe_c2_firms value = prev.pe_mem_2 }
			change_variable = { which = pe_c3_firms value = prev.pe_mem_3 }
			change_variable = { which = pe_c4_firms value = prev.pe_mem_4 }
			change_variable = { which = pe_c5_firms value = prev.pe_mem_5 }
			change_variable = { which = pe_c6_firms value = prev.pe_mem_6 }
			change_variable = { which = pe_c7_firms value = prev.pe_mem_7 }
			change_variable = { which = pe_c8_firms value = prev.pe_mem_8 }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { NOT = { is_variable_set = pe_c1_cash } } set_variable = { which = pe_c1_cash value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c1_cashr value = pe_c1_cash }
	round_variable = pe_c1_cashr
	if = { limit = { NOT = { is_variable_set = pe_c2_cash } } set_variable = { which = pe_c2_cash value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c2_cashr value = pe_c2_cash }
	round_variable = pe_c2_cashr
	if = { limit = { NOT = { is_variable_set = pe_c3_cash } } set_variable = { which = pe_c3_cash value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c3_cashr value = pe_c3_cash }
	round_variable = pe_c3_cashr
	if = { limit = { NOT = { is_variable_set = pe_c4_cash } } set_variable = { which = pe_c4_cash value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c4_cashr value = pe_c4_cash }
	round_variable = pe_c4_cashr
	if = { limit = { NOT = { is_variable_set = pe_c5_cash } } set_variable = { which = pe_c5_cash value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c5_cashr value = pe_c5_cash }
	round_variable = pe_c5_cashr
	if = { limit = { NOT = { is_variable_set = pe_c6_cash } } set_variable = { which = pe_c6_cash value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c6_cashr value = pe_c6_cash }
	round_variable = pe_c6_cashr
	if = { limit = { NOT = { is_variable_set = pe_c7_cash } } set_variable = { which = pe_c7_cash value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c7_cashr value = pe_c7_cash }
	round_variable = pe_c7_cashr
	if = { limit = { NOT = { is_variable_set = pe_c8_cash } } set_variable = { which = pe_c8_cash value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c8_cashr value = pe_c8_cash }
	round_variable = pe_c8_cashr
}

# Country scope: free the slot root.pe_corp_free_k (its headquarters, its name, its rival);

# Country scope, quarterly: a corporation without firms is dissolved.
pe_corp_dissolve = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c1_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c1_firms value < 1 } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c1_name }
		capital_scope = { save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet }
		pe_corp_msg = { KEY = pe_msg_corp_gone }
		set_variable = { which = pe_corp_free_k value = 1 }
		pe_corp_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c2_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c2_firms value < 1 } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c2_name }
		capital_scope = { save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet }
		pe_corp_msg = { KEY = pe_msg_corp_gone }
		set_variable = { which = pe_corp_free_k value = 2 }
		pe_corp_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c3_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c3_firms value < 1 } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c3_name }
		capital_scope = { save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet }
		pe_corp_msg = { KEY = pe_msg_corp_gone }
		set_variable = { which = pe_corp_free_k value = 3 }
		pe_corp_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c4_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c4_firms value < 1 } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c4_name }
		capital_scope = { save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet }
		pe_corp_msg = { KEY = pe_msg_corp_gone }
		set_variable = { which = pe_corp_free_k value = 4 }
		pe_corp_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c5_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c5_firms value < 1 } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c5_name }
		capital_scope = { save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet }
		pe_corp_msg = { KEY = pe_msg_corp_gone }
		set_variable = { which = pe_corp_free_k value = 5 }
		pe_corp_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c6_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c6_firms value < 1 } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c6_name }
		capital_scope = { save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet }
		pe_corp_msg = { KEY = pe_msg_corp_gone }
		set_variable = { which = pe_corp_free_k value = 6 }
		pe_corp_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c7_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c7_firms value < 1 } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c7_name }
		capital_scope = { save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet }
		pe_corp_msg = { KEY = pe_msg_corp_gone }
		set_variable = { which = pe_corp_free_k value = 7 }
		pe_corp_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c8_firms value < 1 } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c8_name }
		capital_scope = { save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet }
		pe_corp_msg = { KEY = pe_msg_corp_gone }
		set_variable = { which = pe_corp_free_k value = 8 }
		pe_corp_free = yes
	}
}

# Country scope, quarterly: one independent stage-3 firm a quarter (the candidate,
# pe_corp_cand) becomes part of a corporation. If its sector group has fewer than two
# corporations and a slot is free, it founds one: a free name of its group, a magnate as
# chief executive, the headquarters on its planet, half of its capital as seed money (event
# pe.270). Otherwise it joins the smallest corporation of its group, bringing half of its
# capital (a friendly merger, message).
pe_corp_found = {
	set_variable = { which = pe_corp_new value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_on value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_new value = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = pe_c7_on value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_new value = 7 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = pe_c6_on value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_new value = 6 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = pe_c5_on value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_new value = 5 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = pe_c4_on value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_new value = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = pe_c3_on value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_new value = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = pe_c2_on value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_new value = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = pe_c1_on value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_new value = 1 } }
	if = {
		limit = { any_owned_colony = { check_variable = { which = pe_ind3 value > 0 } } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_corp_grp value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_corp_seed value = 0 }
		random_owned_colony = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_ind3 value > 0 } }
			save_event_target_as = pe_corp_planet
			random_deposit = {
				limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 3 } check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 0 } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_corp_cand value = 1 }
				root = { set_variable = { which = pe_corp_prim value = prev.pe_prim } }
				if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 2 } } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_corp_grp value = 1 } } }
				else_if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 3 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 4 } } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_corp_grp value = 2 } } }
				else_if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 5 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 6 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 7 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 8 } } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_corp_grp value = 3 } } }
				else_if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 9 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 10 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 11 } } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_corp_grp value = 4 } } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_fcap }
				multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 }
				root = { set_variable = { which = pe_corp_seed value = prev.pe_tmp } }
			}
		}
		# The corporations of its group, and the smallest of them.
		set_variable = { which = pe_grp_n value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_join value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_join_min value = 100000 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c1_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c1_grp value = pe_corp_grp } }
			change_variable = { which = pe_grp_n value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c1_firms value < pe_join_min } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_join value = 1 }
				set_variable = { which = pe_join_min value = pe_c1_firms }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c2_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c2_grp value = pe_corp_grp } }
			change_variable = { which = pe_grp_n value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c2_firms value < pe_join_min } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_join value = 2 }
				set_variable = { which = pe_join_min value = pe_c2_firms }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c3_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c3_grp value = pe_corp_grp } }
			change_variable = { which = pe_grp_n value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c3_firms value < pe_join_min } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_join value = 3 }
				set_variable = { which = pe_join_min value = pe_c3_firms }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c4_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c4_grp value = pe_corp_grp } }
			change_variable = { which = pe_grp_n value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c4_firms value < pe_join_min } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_join value = 4 }
				set_variable = { which = pe_join_min value = pe_c4_firms }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c5_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c5_grp value = pe_corp_grp } }
			change_variable = { which = pe_grp_n value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c5_firms value < pe_join_min } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_join value = 5 }
				set_variable = { which = pe_join_min value = pe_c5_firms }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c6_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c6_grp value = pe_corp_grp } }
			change_variable = { which = pe_grp_n value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c6_firms value < pe_join_min } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_join value = 6 }
				set_variable = { which = pe_join_min value = pe_c6_firms }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c7_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c7_grp value = pe_corp_grp } }
			change_variable = { which = pe_grp_n value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c7_firms value < pe_join_min } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_join value = 7 }
				set_variable = { which = pe_join_min value = pe_c7_firms }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c8_grp value = pe_corp_grp } }
			change_variable = { which = pe_grp_n value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_firms value < pe_join_min } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_join value = 8 }
				set_variable = { which = pe_join_min value = pe_c8_firms }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { which = pe_corp_new value > 0 }
				check_variable = { which = pe_grp_n value < 2 }
			}
			pe_corp_found_new = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_join value > 0 } }
			event_target:pe_corp_planet = {
				random_deposit = {
					limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms check_variable = { which = pe_corp_cand value = 1 } }
					set_variable = { which = pe_corp value = root.pe_join }
					subtract_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_corp_seed }
				}
				change_variable = { which = pe_ind3 value = -1 }
				if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_join value = 1 } } } change_variable = { which = pe_mem_1 value = 1 } }
				else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_join value = 2 } } } change_variable = { which = pe_mem_2 value = 1 } }
				else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_join value = 3 } } } change_variable = { which = pe_mem_3 value = 1 } }
				else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_join value = 4 } } } change_variable = { which = pe_mem_4 value = 1 } }
				else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_join value = 5 } } } change_variable = { which = pe_mem_5 value = 1 } }
				else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_join value = 6 } } } change_variable = { which = pe_mem_6 value = 1 } }
				else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_join value = 7 } } } change_variable = { which = pe_mem_7 value = 1 } }
				else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_join value = 8 } } } change_variable = { which = pe_mem_8 value = 1 } }
				save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet
			}
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_join value = 1 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c1_cash value = pe_corp_seed } change_variable = { which = pe_c1_firms value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c1_name } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_join value = 2 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c2_cash value = pe_corp_seed } change_variable = { which = pe_c2_firms value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c2_name } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_join value = 3 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c3_cash value = pe_corp_seed } change_variable = { which = pe_c3_firms value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c3_name } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_join value = 4 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c4_cash value = pe_corp_seed } change_variable = { which = pe_c4_firms value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c4_name } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_join value = 5 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c5_cash value = pe_corp_seed } change_variable = { which = pe_c5_firms value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c5_name } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_join value = 6 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c6_cash value = pe_corp_seed } change_variable = { which = pe_c6_firms value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c6_name } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_join value = 7 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c7_cash value = pe_corp_seed } change_variable = { which = pe_c7_firms value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c7_name } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_join value = 8 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c8_cash value = pe_corp_seed } change_variable = { which = pe_c8_firms value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c8_name } }
			pe_corp_msg = { KEY = pe_msg_corp_join }
		}
		event_target:pe_corp_planet = {
			every_deposit = {
				limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms check_variable = { which = pe_corp_cand value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_corp_cand value = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: the candidate (pe_corp_cand on event_target:pe_corp_planet) founds a
# corporation in slot pe_corp_new.
pe_corp_found_new = {
		event_target:pe_corp_planet = {
			random_deposit = {
				limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms check_variable = { which = pe_corp_cand value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_corp value = root.pe_corp_new }
				subtract_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_corp_seed }
			}
			change_variable = { which = pe_ind3 value = -1 }
			if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_corp_new value = 1 } } } set_planet_flag = pe_hq_1 change_variable = { which = pe_mem_1 value = 1 } }
			else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_corp_new value = 2 } } } set_planet_flag = pe_hq_2 change_variable = { which = pe_mem_2 value = 1 } }
			else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_corp_new value = 3 } } } set_planet_flag = pe_hq_3 change_variable = { which = pe_mem_3 value = 1 } }
			else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_corp_new value = 4 } } } set_planet_flag = pe_hq_4 change_variable = { which = pe_mem_4 value = 1 } }
			else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_corp_new value = 5 } } } set_planet_flag = pe_hq_5 change_variable = { which = pe_mem_5 value = 1 } }

		}

# Country scope, quarterly: each corporation with enough cash may take over one independent
# firm of its sector group (35% per quarter). It pays the owners 30% of what the district
# costs (city 150 / rural 90 x stage size) into the investor pool.
pe_corp_acquire = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_on value = 1 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_grp value = 1 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_cash value >= 90 }
			any_owned_colony = { check_variable = { which = pe_ind_g1 value > 0 } }
		}
		random = {
			chance = 35
			set_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 0 }
			random_owned_colony = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_ind_g1 value > 0 } }
				save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet
				random_deposit = {
					limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 0 } OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 2 } } }
					set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_stage }
					change_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 }
					multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 }
					if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } } } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 150 } }
					else = { multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 90 } }
					if = {
						limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_c1_cash value >= prev.pe_tmp } } }
						set_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 1 }
						root = {
							subtract_variable = { which = pe_c1_cash value = prev.pe_tmp }
							change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_tmp }
							set_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 1 }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 1 } } }
					change_variable = { which = pe_ind_g1 value = -1 }
					change_variable = { which = pe_mem_1 value = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c1_name }
				pe_corp_msg = { KEY = pe_msg_corp_acq }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_on value = 1 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_grp value = 2 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_cash value >= 90 }
			any_owned_colony = { check_variable = { which = pe_ind_g2 value > 0 } }
		}
		random = {
			chance = 35
			set_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 0 }
			random_owned_colony = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_ind_g2 value > 0 } }
				save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet
				random_deposit = {
					limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 0 } OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 3 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 4 } } }
					set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_stage }
					change_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 }
					multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 }
					if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } } } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 150 } }
					else = { multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 90 } }
					if = {
						limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_c1_cash value >= prev.pe_tmp } } }
						set_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 1 }
						root = {
							subtract_variable = { which = pe_c1_cash value = prev.pe_tmp }
							change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_tmp }
							set_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 1 }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 1 } } }
					change_variable = { which = pe_ind_g2 value = -1 }
					change_variable = { which = pe_mem_1 value = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c1_name }
				pe_corp_msg = { KEY = pe_msg_corp_acq }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_on value = 1 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_grp value = 3 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_cash value >= 90 }
			any_owned_colony = { check_variable = { which = pe_ind_g3 value > 0 } }
		}
		random = {
			chance = 35
			set_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 0 }
			random_owned_colony = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_ind_g3 value > 0 } }
				save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet
				random_deposit = {
					limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 0 } OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 5 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 6 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 7 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 8 } } }
					set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_stage }
					change_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 }
					multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 }
					if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } } } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 150 } }
					else = { multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 90 } }
					if = {
						limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_c1_cash value >= prev.pe_tmp } } }
						set_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 1 }
						root = {
							subtract_variable = { which = pe_c1_cash value = prev.pe_tmp }
							change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_tmp }
							set_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 1 }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 1 } } }
					change_variable = { which = pe_ind_g3 value = -1 }
					change_variable = { which = pe_mem_1 value = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c1_name }
				pe_corp_msg = { KEY = pe_msg_corp_acq }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_on value = 1 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_grp value = 4 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_cash value >= 90 }
			any_owned_colony = { check_variable = { which = pe_ind_g4 value > 0 } }
		}
		random = {
			chance = 35
			set_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 0 }
			random_owned_colony = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_ind_g4 value > 0 } }
				save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet
				random_deposit = {
					limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 0 } OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 9 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 10 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 11 } } }
					set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_stage }
					change_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 }
					multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 }
					if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } } } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 150 } }
					else = { multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 90 } }
					if = {
						limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_c1_cash value >= prev.pe_tmp } } }
						set_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 1 }
						root = {
							subtract_variable = { which = pe_c1_cash value = prev.pe_tmp }
							change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_tmp }
							set_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 1 }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 1 } } }
					change_variable = { which = pe_ind_g4 value = -1 }
					change_variable = { which = pe_mem_1 value = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c1_name }
				pe_corp_msg = { KEY = pe_msg_corp_acq }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { which = pe_c2_on value = 1 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c2_grp value = 1 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c2_cash value >= 90 }
			any_owned_colony = { check_variable = { which = pe_ind_g1 value > 0 } }
		}
		random = {
			chance = 35
			set_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 0 }
			random_owned_colony = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_ind_g1 value > 0 } }
				save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet
				random_deposit = {
					limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 0 } OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 2 } } }
					set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_stage }
					change_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 }
					multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 }
					if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } } } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 150 } }
					else = { multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 90 } }
					if = {
						limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_c2_cash value >= prev.pe_tmp } } }
						set_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 2 }
						root = {
							subtract_variable = { which = pe_c2_cash value = prev.pe_tmp }
							change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_tmp }
							set_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 1 }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 1 } } }
					change_variable = { which = pe_ind_g1 value = -1 }
					change_variable = { which = pe_mem_2 value = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c2_name }
				pe_corp_msg = { KEY = pe_msg_corp_acq }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { which = pe_c2_on value = 1 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c2_grp value = 2 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c2_cash value >= 90 }
			any_owned_colony = { check_variable = { which = pe_ind_g2 value > 0 } }
		}
		random = {
			chance = 35
			set_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 0 }
			random_owned_colony = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_ind_g2 value > 0 } }
				save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet
				random_deposit = {
					limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 0 } OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 3 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 4 } } }
					set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_stage }
					change_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 }
					multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 }
					if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } } } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 150 } }

				set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c7_name }
				pe_corp_msg = { KEY = pe_msg_corp_acq }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { which = pe_c7_on value = 1 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c7_grp value = 4 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c7_cash value >= 90 }
			any_owned_colony = { check_variable = { which = pe_ind_g4 value > 0 } }
		}
		random = {
			chance = 35
			set_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 0 }
			random_owned_colony = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_ind_g4 value > 0 } }
				save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet
				random_deposit = {
					limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 0 } OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 9 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 10 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 11 } } }
					set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_stage }
					change_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 }
					multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 }
					if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } } } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 150 } }
					else = { multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 90 } }
					if = {
						limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_c7_cash value >= prev.pe_tmp } } }
						set_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 7 }
						root = {
							subtract_variable = { which = pe_c7_cash value = prev.pe_tmp }
							change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_tmp }
							set_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 1 }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 1 } } }
					change_variable = { which = pe_ind_g4 value = -1 }
					change_variable = { which = pe_mem_7 value = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c7_name }
				pe_corp_msg = { KEY = pe_msg_corp_acq }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { which = pe_c8_on value = 1 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c8_grp value = 1 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c8_cash value >= 90 }
			any_owned_colony = { check_variable = { which = pe_ind_g1 value > 0 } }
		}
		random = {
			chance = 35
			set_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 0 }
			random_owned_colony = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_ind_g1 value > 0 } }
				save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet
				random_deposit = {
					limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 0 } OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 2 } } }
					set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_stage }
					change_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 }
					multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 }
					if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } } } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 150 } }
					else = { multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 90 } }
					if = {
						limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_cash value >= prev.pe_tmp } } }
						set_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 8 }
						root = {
							subtract_variable = { which = pe_c8_cash value = prev.pe_tmp }
							change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_tmp }
							set_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 1 }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 1 } } }
					change_variable = { which = pe_ind_g1 value = -1 }
					change_variable = { which = pe_mem_8 value = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c8_name }
				pe_corp_msg = { KEY = pe_msg_corp_acq }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { which = pe_c8_on value = 1 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c8_grp value = 2 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c8_cash value >= 90 }
			any_owned_colony = { check_variable = { which = pe_ind_g2 value > 0 } }
		}
		random = {
			chance = 35
			set_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 0 }
			random_owned_colony = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_ind_g2 value > 0 } }
				save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet
				random_deposit = {
					limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 0 } OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 3 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 4 } } }
					set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_stage }
					change_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 }
					multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 }
					if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } } } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 150 } }
					else = { multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 90 } }
					if = {
						limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_cash value >= prev.pe_tmp } } }
						set_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 8 }
						root = {
							subtract_variable = { which = pe_c8_cash value = prev.pe_tmp }
							change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_tmp }
							set_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 1 }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 1 } } }
					change_variable = { which = pe_ind_g2 value = -1 }
					change_variable = { which = pe_mem_8 value = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c8_name }
				pe_corp_msg = { KEY = pe_msg_corp_acq }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { which = pe_c8_on value = 1 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c8_grp value = 3 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c8_cash value >= 90 }
			any_owned_colony = { check_variable = { which = pe_ind_g3 value > 0 } }
		}
		random = {
			chance = 35
			set_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 0 }
			random_owned_colony = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_ind_g3 value > 0 } }
				save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet
				random_deposit = {
					limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 0 } OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 5 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 6 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 7 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 8 } } }
					set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_stage }
					change_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 }
					multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 }
					if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } } } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 150 } }
					else = { multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 90 } }
					if = {
						limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_cash value >= prev.pe_tmp } } }
						set_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 8 }
						root = {
							subtract_variable = { which = pe_c8_cash value = prev.pe_tmp }
							change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_tmp }
							set_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 1 }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 1 } } }
					change_variable = { which = pe_ind_g3 value = -1 }
					change_variable = { which = pe_mem_8 value = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {

				set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c8_name }
				pe_corp_msg = { KEY = pe_msg_corp_acq }

	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { which = pe_c8_on value = 1 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c8_grp value = 4 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c8_cash value >= 90 }
			any_owned_colony = { check_variable = { which = pe_ind_g4 value > 0 } }

		random = {
			chance = 35
			set_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 0 }

				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_ind_g4 value > 0 } }
				save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet
				random_deposit = {
					limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 0 } OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 9 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 10 } check_variable = { which = pe_prim value = 11 } } }
					set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_stage }
					change_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 }
					multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 }
					if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } } } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 150 } }
					else = { multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 90 } }
					if = {
						limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_cash value >= prev.pe_tmp } } }
						set_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 8 }
						root = {

							change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_tmp }

					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 1 } } }

			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_acq_ok value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c8_name }
				pe_corp_msg = { KEY = pe_msg_corp_acq }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope, quarterly: price wars. Two corporations of the same sector group with at
# least 3 firms each and no war in the last ten years: 10% per quarter. A war lasts three
# years (pe_c<slot>_war in quarters; their firms make 30% less profit, see pe_firm_book);
# then the weaker one (fewer firms, then less cash) gives up: merger event pe.272.
pe_corp_rivalry = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c1_war value > 0 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c1_war value = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c1_wcd value > 0 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c1_wcd value = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c2_war value > 0 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c2_war value = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c2_wcd value > 0 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c2_wcd value = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c3_war value > 0 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c3_war value = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c3_wcd value > 0 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c3_wcd value = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c4_war value > 0 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c4_war value = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c4_wcd value > 0 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c4_wcd value = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c5_war value > 0 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c5_war value = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c5_wcd value > 0 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c5_wcd value = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c6_war value > 0 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c6_war value = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c6_wcd value > 0 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c6_wcd value = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c7_war value > 0 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c7_war value = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c7_wcd value > 0 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c7_wcd value = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_war value > 0 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c8_war value = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_wcd value > 0 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c8_wcd value = -1 } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c2_on value = 1 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_rival value = 2 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_war value < 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c2_war value < 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					check_variable = { which = pe_c1_firms value > pe_c2_firms }
					AND = { check_variable = { which = pe_c1_firms value = pe_c2_firms } check_variable = { which = pe_c1_cash value >= pe_c2_cash } }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 2 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_corp_a_name value = pe_c1_name } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_b_name value = pe_c2_name }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 1 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_corp_a_name value = pe_c2_name } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_b_name value = pe_c1_name }
		}
		set_variable = { which = pe_c1_rival value = 0 } set_variable = { which = pe_c2_rival value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_c1_wcd value = 40 } set_variable = { which = pe_c2_wcd value = 40 }
		country_event = { id = pe.272 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c2_on value = 1 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_grp value = pe_c2_grp }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_firms value >= 3 } check_variable = { which = pe_c2_firms value >= 3 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_rival value = 0 } check_variable = { which = pe_c2_rival value = 0 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_wcd value < 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c2_wcd value < 1 }
		}
		random = {
			chance = 10
			set_variable = { which = pe_c1_war value = 12 } set_variable = { which = pe_c2_war value = 12 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_c1_rival value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_c2_rival value = 1 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 2 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_corp_a_name value = pe_c1_name } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_b_name value = pe_c2_name }
			country_event = { id = pe.271 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c3_on value = 1 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_rival value = 3 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_war value < 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c3_war value < 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					check_variable = { which = pe_c1_firms value > pe_c3_firms }
					AND = { check_variable = { which = pe_c1_firms value = pe_c3_firms } check_variable = { which = pe_c1_cash value >= pe_c3_cash } }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 3 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_corp_a_name value = pe_c1_name } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_b_name value = pe_c3_name }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 3 } set_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 1 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_corp_a_name value = pe_c3_name } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_b_name value = pe_c1_name }
		}
		set_variable = { which = pe_c1_rival value = 0 } set_variable = { which = pe_c3_rival value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_c1_wcd value = 40 } set_variable = { which = pe_c3_wcd value = 40 }
		country_event = { id = pe.272 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c3_on value = 1 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_grp value = pe_c3_grp }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_firms value >= 3 } check_variable = { which = pe_c3_firms value >= 3 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_rival value = 0 } check_variable = { which = pe_c3_rival value = 0 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_wcd value < 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c3_wcd value < 1 }
		}
		random = {
			chance = 10
			set_variable = { which = pe_c1_war value = 12 } set_variable = { which = pe_c3_war value = 12 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_c1_rival value = 3 } set_variable = { which = pe_c3_rival value = 1 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 3 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_corp_a_name value = pe_c1_name } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_b_name value = pe_c3_name }
			country_event = { id = pe.271 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c4_on value = 1 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_rival value = 4 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_war value < 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c4_war value < 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					check_variable = { which = pe_c1_firms value > pe_c4_firms }
					AND = { check_variable = { which = pe_c1_firms value = pe_c4_firms } check_variable = { which = pe_c1_cash value >= pe_c4_cash } }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 4 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_corp_a_name value = pe_c1_name } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_b_name value = pe_c4_name }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 4 } set_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 1 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_corp_a_name value = pe_c4_name } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_b_name value = pe_c1_name }
		}
		set_variable = { which = pe_c1_rival value = 0 } set_variable = { which = pe_c4_rival value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_c1_wcd value = 40 } set_variable = { which = pe_c4_wcd value = 40 }
		country_event = { id = pe.272 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c4_on value = 1 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_grp value = pe_c4_grp }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_firms value >= 3 } check_variable = { which = pe_c4_firms value >= 3 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_rival value = 0 } check_variable = { which = pe_c4_rival value = 0 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_wcd value < 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c4_wcd value < 1 }
		}
		random = {
			chance = 10
			set_variable = { which = pe_c1_war value = 12 } set_variable = { which = pe_c4_war value = 12 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_c1_rival value = 4 } set_variable = { which = pe_c4_rival value = 1 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 4 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_corp_a_name value = pe_c1_name } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_b_name value = pe_c4_name }
			country_event = { id = pe.271 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c5_on value = 1 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_rival value = 5 }
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_war value < 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c5_war value < 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					check_variable = { which = pe_c1_firms value > pe_c5_firms }
					AND = { check_variable = { which = pe_c1_firms value = pe_c5_firms } check_variable = { which = pe_c1_cash value >= pe_c5_cash } }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 5 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_corp_a_name value = pe_c1_name } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_b_name value = pe_c5_name }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 5 } set_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 1 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_corp_a_name value = pe_c5_name } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_b_name value = pe_c1_name }
		}
		set_variable = { which = pe_c1_rival value = 0 } set_variable = { which = pe_c5_rival value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_c1_wcd value = 40 } set_variable = { which = pe_c5_wcd value = 40 }
		country_event = { id = pe.272 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { which = pe_c1_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c5_on value = 1 }

# Country scope (event pe.271): both sides of the price war (pe_mg_s, pe_mg_w) fight on for
# root.pe_war_len quarters.
pe_corp_set_war = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = pe_c1_war value = pe_war_len } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 2 } } set_variable = { which = pe_c2_war value = pe_war_len } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 3 } } set_variable = { which = pe_c3_war value = pe_war_len } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 4 } } set_variable = { which = pe_c4_war value = pe_war_len } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 5 } } set_variable = { which = pe_c5_war value = pe_war_len } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 6 } } set_variable = { which = pe_c6_war value = pe_war_len } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 7 } } set_variable = { which = pe_c7_war value = pe_war_len } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 8 } } set_variable = { which = pe_c8_war value = pe_war_len } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = pe_c1_war value = pe_war_len } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 2 } } set_variable = { which = pe_c2_war value = pe_war_len } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 3 } } set_variable = { which = pe_c3_war value = pe_war_len } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 4 } } set_variable = { which = pe_c4_war value = pe_war_len } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 5 } } set_variable = { which = pe_c5_war value = pe_war_len } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 6 } } set_variable = { which = pe_c6_war value = pe_war_len } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 7 } } set_variable = { which = pe_c7_war value = pe_war_len } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 8 } } set_variable = { which = pe_c8_war value = pe_war_len } }
}

# Country scope (event pe.272): the weaker corporation (pe_mg_w) merges into the stronger
# (pe_mg_s): its firms and cash change hands, its slot is freed.
pe_corp_merge = {
	every_owned_colony = {
		every_deposit = {
			limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = root.pe_mg_w } }
			set_variable = { which = pe_corp value = root.pe_mg_s }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_c1_cash } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 2 } } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_c2_cash } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 3 } } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_c3_cash } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 4 } } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_c4_cash } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 5 } } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_c5_cash } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 6 } } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_c6_cash } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 7 } } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_c7_cash } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 8 } } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_c8_cash } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 1 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c1_cash value = pe_tmp } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 2 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c2_cash value = pe_tmp } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 3 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c3_cash value = pe_tmp } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 4 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c4_cash value = pe_tmp } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 5 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c5_cash value = pe_tmp } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 6 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c6_cash value = pe_tmp } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 7 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c7_cash value = pe_tmp } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 8 } } change_variable = { which = pe_c8_cash value = pe_tmp } }
	every_planet_within_border = {
		limit = { has_orbital_station = yes }
		orbital_station = {
			if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 1 } } } if = { limit = { has_fleet_flag = pe_stc_1 } remove_fleet_flag = pe_stc_1 if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 1 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_1 } else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 2 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_2 } else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 3 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_3 } else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 4 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_4 } else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 5 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_5 } else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 6 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_6 } else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 7 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_7 } else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 8 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_8 } } }
			else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 2 } } } if = { limit = { has_fleet_flag = pe_stc_2 } remove_fleet_flag = pe_stc_2 if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 1 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_1 } else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 2 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_2 } else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 3 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_3 } else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 4 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_4 } else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 5 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_5 } else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 6 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_6 } else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 7 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_7 } else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 8 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_8 } } }

			else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 8 } } } if = { limit = { has_fleet_flag = pe_stc_8 } remove_fleet_flag = pe_stc_8 if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 1 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_1 } else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 2 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_2 } else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 3 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_3 } else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 4 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_4 } else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 5 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_5 } else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 6 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_6 } else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 7 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_7 } else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_s value = 8 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_8 } } }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { which = pe_corp_free_k value = pe_mg_w }
	pe_corp_free = yes
}

# Country scope (event pe.272): a merger forbidden. The weaker corporation pays a quarter of
# its cash in costs and stays on its own.
pe_corp_fine = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 1 } } multiply_variable = { which = pe_c1_cash value = 0.75 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 2 } } multiply_variable = { which = pe_c2_cash value = 0.75 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 3 } } multiply_variable = { which = pe_c3_cash value = 0.75 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 4 } } multiply_variable = { which = pe_c4_cash value = 0.75 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 5 } } multiply_variable = { which = pe_c5_cash value = 0.75 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 6 } } multiply_variable = { which = pe_c6_cash value = 0.75 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 7 } } multiply_variable = { which = pe_c7_cash value = 0.75 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_w value = 8 } } multiply_variable = { which = pe_c8_cash value = 0.75 } }
}
