# Country scope (Command Economy): all corporations end.
pe_corp_reset = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c1_on value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_free_k value = 1 } pe_corp_free = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c2_on value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_free_k value = 2 } pe_corp_free = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c3_on value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_free_k value = 3 } pe_corp_free = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c4_on value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_free_k value = 4 } pe_corp_free = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c5_on value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_free_k value = 5 } pe_corp_free = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c6_on value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_free_k value = 6 } pe_corp_free = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c7_on value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_free_k value = 7 } pe_corp_free = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_on value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_free_k value = 8 } pe_corp_free = yes }
	every_owned_colony = {
		if = { limit = { has_modifier = pe_price_war } remove_modifier = pe_price_war }
	}
}

# Colony scope, quarterly (after the accounts): corporate loans. A firm that wants to grow but
# lacks the capital (pe_want_loan, pe_want_cost) or has run into losses (pe_want_bridge) asks
# its own corporation first, then the one with the most cash. A corporation lends while its
# cash stays above -200. A growth loan pays the next stage at once (one stage change per
# planet and quarter); a bridging loan covers the loss. Without a lender a firm in losses
# shrinks or goes bankrupt as before.
pe_corp_lending = {
	every_deposit = {
		limit = {
			has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms
			OR = {
				check_variable = { which = pe_want_loan value > 0 }
				check_variable = { which = pe_want_bridge value > 0 }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { which = pe_lamt value = pe_want_loan }
		change_variable = { which = pe_lamt value = pe_want_bridge }
		set_variable = { which = pe_lneed value = pe_lamt }
		change_variable = { which = pe_lneed value = -200 }
		root = {
			set_variable = { which = pe_lend_k value = 0 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_lend_best value = -200 }
		}
		# A growth loan only if this planet has no stage change yet this quarter.
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					check_variable = { which = pe_want_bridge value > 0 }
					root = { check_variable = { which = pe_pend_any value = 0 } }
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 1 } root = { check_variable = { which = pe_c1_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c1_cash value >= prev.pe_lneed } } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_lend_k value = 1 } } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 2 } root = { check_variable = { which = pe_c2_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c2_cash value >= prev.pe_lneed } } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_lend_k value = 2 } } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 3 } root = { check_variable = { which = pe_c3_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c3_cash value >= prev.pe_lneed } } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_lend_k value = 3 } } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 4 } root = { check_variable = { which = pe_c4_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c4_cash value >= prev.pe_lneed } } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_lend_k value = 4 } } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 5 } root = { check_variable = { which = pe_c5_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c5_cash value >= prev.pe_lneed } } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_lend_k value = 5 } } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 6 } root = { check_variable = { which = pe_c6_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c6_cash value >= prev.pe_lneed } } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_lend_k value = 6 } } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 7 } root = { check_variable = { which = pe_c7_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c7_cash value >= prev.pe_lneed } } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_lend_k value = 7 } } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 8 } root = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c8_cash value >= prev.pe_lneed } } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_lend_k value = 8 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_lend_k value = 0 } } }
				if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_c1_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c1_cash value >= prev.pe_lneed } check_variable = { which = pe_c1_cash value > pe_lend_best } } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_lend_k value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_lend_best value = pe_c1_cash } } }
				if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_c2_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c2_cash value >= prev.pe_lneed } check_variable = { which = pe_c2_cash value > pe_lend_best } } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_lend_k value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_lend_best value = pe_c2_cash } } }
				if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_c3_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c3_cash value >= prev.pe_lneed } check_variable = { which = pe_c3_cash value > pe_lend_best } } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_lend_k value = 3 } set_variable = { which = pe_lend_best value = pe_c3_cash } } }
				if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_c4_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c4_cash value >= prev.pe_lneed } check_variable = { which = pe_c4_cash value > pe_lend_best } } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_lend_k value = 4 } set_variable = { which = pe_lend_best value = pe_c4_cash } } }
				if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_c5_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c5_cash value >= prev.pe_lneed } check_variable = { which = pe_c5_cash value > pe_lend_best } } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_lend_k value = 5 } set_variable = { which = pe_lend_best value = pe_c5_cash } } }
				if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_c6_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c6_cash value >= prev.pe_lneed } check_variable = { which = pe_c6_cash value > pe_lend_best } } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_lend_k value = 6 } set_variable = { which = pe_lend_best value = pe_c6_cash } } }
				if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_c7_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c7_cash value >= prev.pe_lneed } check_variable = { which = pe_c7_cash value > pe_lend_best } } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_lend_k value = 7 } set_variable = { which = pe_lend_best value = pe_c7_cash } } }
				if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c8_cash value >= prev.pe_lneed } check_variable = { which = pe_c8_cash value > pe_lend_best } } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_lend_k value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_lend_best value = pe_c8_cash } } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_lend_k value > 0 } } }
			if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_lend_k value = 1 } } } root = { subtract_variable = { which = pe_c1_cash value = prev.pe_lamt } } }
			else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_lend_k value = 2 } } } root = { subtract_variable = { which = pe_c2_cash value = prev.pe_lamt } } }
			else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_lend_k value = 3 } } } root = { subtract_variable = { which = pe_c3_cash value = prev.pe_lamt } } }
			else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_lend_k value = 4 } } } root = { subtract_variable = { which = pe_c4_cash value = prev.pe_lamt } } }
			else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_lend_k value = 5 } } } root = { subtract_variable = { which = pe_c5_cash value = prev.pe_lamt } } }
			else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_lend_k value = 6 } } } root = { subtract_variable = { which = pe_c6_cash value = prev.pe_lamt } } }
			else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_lend_k value = 7 } } } root = { subtract_variable = { which = pe_c7_cash value = prev.pe_lamt } } }
			else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_lend_k value = 8 } } } root = { subtract_variable = { which = pe_c8_cash value = prev.pe_lamt } } }
			change_variable = { which = pe_loan value = pe_lamt }
			set_variable = { which = pe_lender value = root.pe_lend_k }
			change_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = pe_lamt }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_want_loan value > 0 } }
				subtract_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = pe_want_cost }
				set_variable = { which = pe_pending value = 1 }
				root = { set_variable = { which = pe_pend_any value = 1 } }
			}
			else = { change_variable = { which = pe_loan_q value = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { which = pe_want_bridge value > 0 }
				root = { check_variable = { which = pe_pend_any value = 0 } }
			}
			set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = 0 }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_stage value > 1 } } set_variable = { which = pe_pending value = 2 } }
			else = { set_variable = { which = pe_pending value = 3 } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_pend_any value = 1 } }
		}
		set_variable = { which = pe_want_loan value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_want_bridge value = 0 }
	}
}

# Country scope, quarterly: a corporation whose cash is below zero (too many loans, too many
# defaults) sells one of its firms. It becomes independent; the investor pool pays the
# corporation 30% of what the district costs (city 150 / rural 90 x stage size). Message.
pe_corp_crisis = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c1_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c1_cash value < 0 } any_owned_colony = { check_variable = { which = pe_mem_1 value > 0 } } }
		random_owned_colony = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mem_1 value > 0 } }
			save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet
			random_deposit = {
				limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 0 }
				set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_stage }
				change_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 }
				multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 }
				if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } } } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 150 } }
				else = { multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 90 } }
				root = {
					change_variable = { which = pe_c1_cash value = prev.pe_tmp }
					subtract_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_tmp }
				}
			}
			change_variable = { which = pe_mem_1 value = -1 }
		}
		change_variable = { which = pe_c1_firms value = -1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c1_name }
		pe_corp_msg = { KEY = pe_msg_corp_crisis }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c2_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c2_cash value < 0 } any_owned_colony = { check_variable = { which = pe_mem_2 value > 0 } } }
		random_owned_colony = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mem_2 value > 0 } }
			save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet
			random_deposit = {
				limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 2 } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 0 }
				set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_stage }
				change_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 }
				multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 }
				if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } } } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 150 } }
				else = { multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 90 } }
				root = {
					change_variable = { which = pe_c2_cash value = prev.pe_tmp }
					subtract_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_tmp }
				}
			}
			change_variable = { which = pe_mem_2 value = -1 }
		}
		change_variable = { which = pe_c2_firms value = -1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c2_name }
		pe_corp_msg = { KEY = pe_msg_corp_crisis }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c3_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c3_cash value < 0 } any_owned_colony = { check_variable = { which = pe_mem_3 value > 0 } } }
		random_owned_colony = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mem_3 value > 0 } }
			save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet
			random_deposit = {
				limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 3 } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 0 }
				set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_stage }
				change_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 }
				multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 }
				if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } } } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 150 } }
				else = { multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 90 } }
				root = {
					change_variable = { which = pe_c3_cash value = prev.pe_tmp }
					subtract_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_tmp }
				}
			}
			change_variable = { which = pe_mem_3 value = -1 }
		}
		change_variable = { which = pe_c3_firms value = -1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c3_name }
		pe_corp_msg = { KEY = pe_msg_corp_crisis }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c4_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c4_cash value < 0 } any_owned_colony = { check_variable = { which = pe_mem_4 value > 0 } } }
		random_owned_colony = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mem_4 value > 0 } }
			save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet
			random_deposit = {
				limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 4 } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 0 }
				set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_stage }
				change_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 }
				multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 }
				if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } } } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 150 } }
				else = { multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 90 } }
				root = {
					change_variable = { which = pe_c4_cash value = prev.pe_tmp }
					subtract_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_tmp }
				}
			}
			change_variable = { which = pe_mem_4 value = -1 }
		}
		change_variable = { which = pe_c4_firms value = -1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c4_name }
		pe_corp_msg = { KEY = pe_msg_corp_crisis }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c5_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c5_cash value < 0 } any_owned_colony = { check_variable = { which = pe_mem_5 value > 0 } } }
		random_owned_colony = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mem_5 value > 0 } }
			save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet
			random_deposit = {
				limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 5 } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 0 }
				set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_stage }
				change_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 }
				multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 }
				if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } } } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 150 } }
				else = { multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 90 } }
				root = {
					change_variable = { which = pe_c5_cash value = prev.pe_tmp }
					subtract_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_tmp }
				}
			}
			change_variable = { which = pe_mem_5 value = -1 }
		}
		change_variable = { which = pe_c5_firms value = -1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c5_name }
		pe_corp_msg = { KEY = pe_msg_corp_crisis }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c6_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c6_cash value < 0 } any_owned_colony = { check_variable = { which = pe_mem_6 value > 0 } } }
		random_owned_colony = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mem_6 value > 0 } }
			save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet
			random_deposit = {
				limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 6 } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 0 }
				set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_stage }
				change_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 }
				multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 }
				if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } } } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 150 } }
				else = { multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 90 } }
				root = {
					change_variable = { which = pe_c6_cash value = prev.pe_tmp }
					subtract_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_tmp }
				}
			}
			change_variable = { which = pe_mem_6 value = -1 }
		}
		change_variable = { which = pe_c6_firms value = -1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_c6_name }
		pe_corp_msg = { KEY = pe_msg_corp_crisis }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c7_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c7_cash value < 0 } any_owned_colony = { check_variable = { which = pe_mem_7 value > 0 } } }
		random_owned_colony = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_mem_7 value > 0 } }
			save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet
			random_deposit = {
				limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms check_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 7 } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_corp value = 0 }
				set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_stage }

				if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } } } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 150 } }
				else = { multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 90 } }
				root = {
					change_variable = { which = pe_c7_cash value = prev.pe_tmp }

	}
}

# Country scope, quarterly: find our holdings (event_target:pe_hold); create them once we
# have a corporation. Our flag, not in the contacts list.
pe_holdings_ensure = {
	random_country = {
		limit = { is_country_type = pe_holdings has_relation_flag = { who = root flag = pe_holdings_of } }
		save_event_target_as = pe_hold
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = event_target:pe_hold }
			OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_c1_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c2_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c3_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c4_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c5_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c6_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c7_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c8_on value = 1 } }
		}
		create_country = {
			name = pe_holdings_name
			type = pe_holdings
			auto_delete = no
			contact_rule = never
			released_by_country = root
			authority = auth_oligarchic
			ethos = { ethic = ethic_materialist ethic = ethic_egalitarian ethic = ethic_xenophile }
			civics = { civic = civic_merchant_guilds civic = civic_mining_guilds }
			remove_invalid_civics = yes
			origin = origin_default
			species = root
			flag = root
			effect = {
				set_relation_flag = { who = root flag = pe_holdings_of }
				save_event_target_as = pe_hold
				add_resource = { energy = 500 }
			}
		}
	}
	# Our own holdings are no strangers (no first contact).
	if = {
		limit = { exists = event_target:pe_hold NOT = { has_communications = event_target:pe_hold } }
		establish_communications_no_message = event_target:pe_hold
	}
}

# Country scope, quarterly: one corporation may take a station (25% a quarter, at most one per
# empire and quarter, then 5 years' pause for that corporation). Private stations stay below a
# share of our stations of ordinary resources: Laissez-faire 40%, Free Market 25%, Mixed 15%.
# A free deposit first (the corporation builds), otherwise one of our stations (it buys).
# Here only the corporation is chosen (pe_st_k); pe_corp_step then calls pe_corp_station_pick.
pe_corp_stations = {
	set_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_st_lim value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_policy_flag = pe_order_laissez_faire } set_variable = { which = pe_st_lim value = 0.4 } }
	if = { limit = { has_policy_flag = pe_order_free_market } set_variable = { which = pe_st_lim value = 0.25 } }
	if = { limit = { has_policy_flag = pe_order_mixed } set_variable = { which = pe_st_lim value = 0.15 } }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = event_target:pe_hold check_variable = { which = pe_st_lim value > 0 } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_st_state value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_st_priv value = 0 }
		every_planet_within_border = {
			limit = { pe_orbital_allowed = yes has_orbital_station = yes }
			if = { limit = { pe_state_station = yes } root = { change_variable = { which = pe_st_state value = 1 } } }
			else_if = { limit = { pe_holdings_station = yes } root = { change_variable = { which = pe_st_priv value = 1 } } }
		}
		# (private + 1) <= limit x (all + 1)
		set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_st_state }
		change_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_st_priv }
		change_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 }
		multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_st_lim }
		set_variable = { which = pe_tmp2 value = pe_st_priv }
		change_variable = { which = pe_tmp2 value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_tmp2 value <= pe_tmp } check_variable = { which = pe_c1_right value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c2_right value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c3_right value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c4_right value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c5_right value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c6_right value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c7_right value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c8_right value = 1 } } }
			random = {
				chance = 25
				set_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 0 }
				random_list = {
					10 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { check_variable = { which = pe_c1_on value = 1 } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c1_scd value > 0 } }
						modifier = { factor = 10 check_variable = { which = pe_c1_right value = 1 } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c1_cash value < 300 } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c1_grp value = 1 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g1 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c1_grp value = 2 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g2 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c1_grp value = 3 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g3 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c1_grp value = 4 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g4 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						set_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 1 }
					}
					10 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { check_variable = { which = pe_c2_on value = 1 } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c2_scd value > 0 } }
						modifier = { factor = 10 check_variable = { which = pe_c2_right value = 1 } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c2_cash value < 300 } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c2_grp value = 1 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g1 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c2_grp value = 2 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g2 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c2_grp value = 3 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g3 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c2_grp value = 4 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g4 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						set_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 2 }
					}
					10 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { check_variable = { which = pe_c3_on value = 1 } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c3_scd value > 0 } }

						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c3_cash value < 300 } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c3_grp value = 1 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g1 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c3_grp value = 2 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g2 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c3_grp value = 3 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g3 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c3_grp value = 4 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g4 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						set_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 3 }
					}
					10 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { check_variable = { which = pe_c4_on value = 1 } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c4_scd value > 0 } }
						modifier = { factor = 10 check_variable = { which = pe_c4_right value = 1 } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c4_cash value < 300 } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c4_grp value = 1 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g1 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c4_grp value = 2 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g2 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c4_grp value = 3 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g3 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c4_grp value = 4 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g4 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						set_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 4 }
					}
					10 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { check_variable = { which = pe_c5_on value = 1 } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c5_scd value > 0 } }
						modifier = { factor = 10 check_variable = { which = pe_c5_right value = 1 } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c5_cash value < 300 } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c5_grp value = 1 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g1 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c5_grp value = 2 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g2 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c5_grp value = 3 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g3 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c5_grp value = 4 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g4 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						set_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 5 }

						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c6_grp value = 1 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g1 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c6_grp value = 2 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g2 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c6_grp value = 3 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g3 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c6_grp value = 4 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g4 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						set_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 6 }

						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c7_scd value > 0 } }
						modifier = { factor = 10 check_variable = { which = pe_c7_right value = 1 } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c7_cash value < 300 } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c7_grp value = 1 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g1 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c7_grp value = 2 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g2 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c7_grp value = 3 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g3 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c7_grp value = 4 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g4 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						set_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 7 }
					}
					10 = {
						modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_on value = 1 } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c8_scd value > 0 } }
						modifier = { factor = 10 check_variable = { which = pe_c8_right value = 1 } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c8_cash value < 300 } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c8_grp value = 1 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g1 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c8_grp value = 2 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g2 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c8_grp value = 3 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g3 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { which = pe_c8_grp value = 4 } NOT = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g4 = yes OR = { has_orbital_station = no pe_state_station = yes } } } }
						set_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 8 }
					}

		}

# Country scope: the corporation pe_st_k picks a deposit (free first) and builds or buys,
# directly under Laissez-faire, by offer (pe.280) under Free Market and Mixed.
pe_corp_station_pick = {
	set_variable = { which = pe_st_mode value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = pe_st_grp value = pe_c1_grp } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_cur_name value = pe_c1_name } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 2 } } set_variable = { which = pe_st_grp value = pe_c2_grp } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_cur_name value = pe_c2_name } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 3 } } set_variable = { which = pe_st_grp value = pe_c3_grp } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_cur_name value = pe_c3_name } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 4 } } set_variable = { which = pe_st_grp value = pe_c4_grp } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_cur_name value = pe_c4_name } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 5 } } set_variable = { which = pe_st_grp value = pe_c5_grp } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_cur_name value = pe_c5_name } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 6 } } set_variable = { which = pe_st_grp value = pe_c6_grp } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_cur_name value = pe_c6_name } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 7 } } set_variable = { which = pe_st_grp value = pe_c7_grp } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_cur_name value = pe_c7_name } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 8 } } set_variable = { which = pe_st_grp value = pe_c8_grp } set_variable = { which = pe_corp_cur_name value = pe_c8_name } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_grp value = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g1 = yes has_orbital_station = no } }
			random_planet_within_border = { limit = { pe_orbital_for_g1 = yes has_orbital_station = no } save_event_target_as = pe_st_planet }
			set_variable = { which = pe_st_mode value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g1 = yes pe_state_station = yes } }
			random_planet_within_border = { limit = { pe_orbital_for_g1 = yes pe_state_station = yes } save_event_target_as = pe_st_planet }
			set_variable = { which = pe_st_mode value = 2 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_grp value = 2 } }
		if = {
			limit = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g2 = yes has_orbital_station = no } }
			random_planet_within_border = { limit = { pe_orbital_for_g2 = yes has_orbital_station = no } save_event_target_as = pe_st_planet }
			set_variable = { which = pe_st_mode value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g2 = yes pe_state_station = yes } }
			random_planet_within_border = { limit = { pe_orbital_for_g2 = yes pe_state_station = yes } save_event_target_as = pe_st_planet }
			set_variable = { which = pe_st_mode value = 2 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_grp value = 3 } }
		if = {
			limit = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g3 = yes has_orbital_station = no } }
			random_planet_within_border = { limit = { pe_orbital_for_g3 = yes has_orbital_station = no } save_event_target_as = pe_st_planet }
			set_variable = { which = pe_st_mode value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g3 = yes pe_state_station = yes } }
			random_planet_within_border = { limit = { pe_orbital_for_g3 = yes pe_state_station = yes } save_event_target_as = pe_st_planet }
			set_variable = { which = pe_st_mode value = 2 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_grp value = 4 } }
		if = {
			limit = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g4 = yes has_orbital_station = no } }
			random_planet_within_border = { limit = { pe_orbital_for_g4 = yes has_orbital_station = no } save_event_target_as = pe_st_planet }
			set_variable = { which = pe_st_mode value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { any_planet_within_border = { pe_orbital_for_g4 = yes pe_state_station = yes } }
			random_planet_within_border = { limit = { pe_orbital_for_g4 = yes pe_state_station = yes } save_event_target_as = pe_st_planet }
			set_variable = { which = pe_st_mode value = 2 }
		}
	}
	# What we get: Laissez-faire nothing for a free deposit, the building cost for a station;
	# Free Market and Mixed a concession fee (the building cost) or twice the building cost,
	# and every year a fifth of the station's value.
	set_variable = { which = pe_st_pay value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_st_share value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_policy_flag = pe_order_laissez_faire }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_mode value = 2 } } set_variable = { which = pe_st_pay value = 100 } }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { which = pe_st_pay value = 100 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_mode value = 2 } } set_variable = { which = pe_st_pay value = 200 } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_st_share value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_mode value > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_policy_flag = pe_order_laissez_faire }
			pe_corp_station_exec = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_ai = yes }
			random = { chance = 70 pe_corp_station_exec = yes }
		}
		else = { country_event = { id = pe.280 } }
	}
}

# Country scope: carry out the station deal (pe_st_k, pe_st_mode 1 build / 2 buy,
# event_target:pe_st_planet). The corporation pays its building cost and what we get from
# its cash; the station belongs to the holdings, flagged with the corporation.
pe_corp_station_exec = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_mode value = 1 } }
		event_target:pe_st_planet = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_deposit_for = shipclass_research_station }
				create_research_station = { owner = event_target:pe_hold }
			}
			else = { create_mining_station = { owner = event_target:pe_hold } }
		}
	}
	else = {
		event_target:pe_st_planet = { orbital_station = { set_owner = event_target:pe_hold } }
	}
	event_target:pe_st_planet = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_orbital_station = yes }
			orbital_station = {
				if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 1 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_1 }
				else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 2 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_2 }
				else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 3 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_3 }
				else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 4 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_4 }
				else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 5 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_5 }
				else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 6 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_6 }
				else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 7 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_7 }
				else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 8 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_stc_8 }
				if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_share value = 1 } } } set_fleet_flag = pe_st_share }
			}
		}
	}
	add_resource = { minerals = 1 mult = pe_st_pay }
	set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_st_pay }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_mode value = 1 } } change_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 100 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 1 } } subtract_variable = { which = pe_c1_cash value = pe_tmp } set_variable = { which = pe_c1_scd value = 20 } set_variable = { which = pe_c1_right value = 0 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 2 } } subtract_variable = { which = pe_c2_cash value = pe_tmp } set_variable = { which = pe_c2_scd value = 20 } set_variable = { which = pe_c2_right value = 0 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 3 } } subtract_variable = { which = pe_c3_cash value = pe_tmp } set_variable = { which = pe_c3_scd value = 20 } set_variable = { which = pe_c3_right value = 0 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 4 } } subtract_variable = { which = pe_c4_cash value = pe_tmp } set_variable = { which = pe_c4_scd value = 20 } set_variable = { which = pe_c4_right value = 0 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 5 } } subtract_variable = { which = pe_c5_cash value = pe_tmp } set_variable = { which = pe_c5_scd value = 20 } set_variable = { which = pe_c5_right value = 0 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 6 } } subtract_variable = { which = pe_c6_cash value = pe_tmp } set_variable = { which = pe_c6_scd value = 20 } set_variable = { which = pe_c6_right value = 0 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 7 } } subtract_variable = { which = pe_c7_cash value = pe_tmp } set_variable = { which = pe_c7_scd value = 20 } set_variable = { which = pe_c7_right value = 0 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_k value = 8 } } subtract_variable = { which = pe_c8_cash value = pe_tmp } set_variable = { which = pe_c8_scd value = 20 } set_variable = { which = pe_c8_right value = 0 } }
	event_target:pe_st_planet = { save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet }
	set_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = pe_corp_cur_name }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_msg_name value = 1 } } if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_st_mode value = 1 } } create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_corp_st_build days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } variable = { type = key value = pe_cname_1 localization = CORP } } } else = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_corp_st_buy days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } variable = { type = key value = pe_cname_1 localization = CORP } } } }

# Country scope, quarterly: what the corporate stations bring. Per corporation its stations'
# value at base prices (pe_c<slot>_sv, per month) and their number (pe_c<slot>_st). The
# holdings hand the stored output to the corporation (it is used up); the corporation
# produces 2 x the value in its own product on its headquarters (pe_cpv_<res> on the
# planet, deposit lines), and books half the value (per quarter: x 3) as its own earnings.
# Stations bought under Free Market or Mixed pay us a fifth of their value a year.
pe_corp_station_output = {
	set_variable = { which = pe_c1_sv value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c1_out value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c1_st value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c1_shv value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c2_sv value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c2_out value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c2_st value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c2_shv value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c3_sv value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c3_out value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c3_st value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c3_shv value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c4_sv value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c4_out value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c4_st value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c4_shv value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c5_sv value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c5_out value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c5_st value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c5_shv value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c6_sv value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c6_out value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c6_st value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c6_shv value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c7_sv value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c7_out value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c7_st value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c7_shv value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c8_sv value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c8_out value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c8_st value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_c8_shv value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_sr_minerals value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_sr_energy value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_sr_food value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_sr_trade value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_sr_alloys value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_sr_consumer_goods value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_sr_unity value = 0 }
	every_owned_colony = {
		set_variable = { which = pe_cpv_alloys value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_cpv_consumer_goods value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_cpv_trade value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_cpv_physics_research value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_cpv_society_research value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_cpv_engineering_research value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_cpv_unity value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_cpv_minerals value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_cpv_energy value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_cpv_food value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = event_target:pe_hold }
		every_planet_within_border = {
			limit = { pe_orbital_allowed = yes pe_holdings_station = yes }
			set_variable = { which = pe_stk value = 0 }
			orbital_station = {
				if = { limit = { has_fleet_flag = pe_stc_1 } prev = { set_variable = { which = pe_stk value = 1 } } }
				else_if = { limit = { has_fleet_flag = pe_stc_2 } prev = { set_variable = { which = pe_stk value = 2 } } }
				else_if = { limit = { has_fleet_flag = pe_stc_3 } prev = { set_variable = { which = pe_stk value = 3 } } }
				else_if = { limit = { has_fleet_flag = pe_stc_4 } prev = { set_variable = { which = pe_stk value = 4 } } }
				else_if = { limit = { has_fleet_flag = pe_stc_5 } prev = { set_variable = { which = pe_stk value = 5 } } }
				else_if = { limit = { has_fleet_flag = pe_stc_6 } prev = { set_variable = { which = pe_stk value = 6 } } }
				else_if = { limit = { has_fleet_flag = pe_stc_7 } prev = { set_variable = { which = pe_stk value = 7 } } }
				else_if = { limit = { has_fleet_flag = pe_stc_8 } prev = { set_variable = { which = pe_stk value = 8 } } }
			}
			set_variable = { which = pe_stval value = 0 }
			if = { limit = { has_deposit = d_minerals_1 } set_variable = { which = pe_stval value = 1 } root = { change_variable = { which = pe_sr_minerals value = 1 } } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_deposit = d_minerals_2 } set_variable = { which = pe_stval value = 2 } root = { change_variable = { which = pe_sr_minerals value = 2 } } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_deposit = d_minerals_3 } set_variable = { which = pe_stval value = 3 } root = { change_variable = { which = pe_sr_minerals value = 3 } } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_deposit = d_minerals_4 } set_variable = { which = pe_stval value = 4 } root = { change_variable = { which = pe_sr_minerals value = 4 } } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_deposit = d_minerals_5 } set_variable = { which = pe_stval value = 5 } root = { change_variable = { which = pe_sr_minerals value = 5 } } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_deposit = d_minerals_6 } set_variable = { which = pe_stval value = 6 } root = { change_variable = { which = pe_sr_minerals value = 6 } } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_deposit = d_minerals_7 } set_variable = { which = pe_stval value = 7 } root = { change_variable = { which = pe_sr_minerals value = 7 } } }

		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c7_prod value = 6 } } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_c7_sv } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5714 } every_owned_colony = { limit = { has_planet_flag = pe_hq_7 } change_variable = { which = pe_cpv_engineering_research value = root.pe_tmp } } set_variable = { which = pe_c7_out value = pe_tmp } round_variable = pe_c7_out }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c7_prod value = 7 } } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_c7_sv } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.6667 } every_owned_colony = { limit = { has_planet_flag = pe_hq_7 } change_variable = { which = pe_cpv_unity value = root.pe_tmp } } set_variable = { which = pe_c7_out value = pe_tmp } round_variable = pe_c7_out }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c7_prod value = 8 } } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_c7_sv } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 2 } every_owned_colony = { limit = { has_planet_flag = pe_hq_7 } change_variable = { which = pe_cpv_minerals value = root.pe_tmp } } set_variable = { which = pe_c7_out value = pe_tmp } round_variable = pe_c7_out }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c7_prod value = 9 } } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_c7_sv } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 2 } every_owned_colony = { limit = { has_planet_flag = pe_hq_7 } change_variable = { which = pe_cpv_energy value = root.pe_tmp } } set_variable = { which = pe_c7_out value = pe_tmp } round_variable = pe_c7_out }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c7_prod value = 10 } } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_c7_sv } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 2 } every_owned_colony = { limit = { has_planet_flag = pe_hq_7 } change_variable = { which = pe_cpv_food value = root.pe_tmp } } set_variable = { which = pe_c7_out value = pe_tmp } round_variable = pe_c7_out }
		set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_c7_sv }
		multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1.5 }
		change_variable = { which = pe_c7_cash value = pe_tmp }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c7_shv value > 0 } }
			set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_c7_shv }
			multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.15 }
			subtract_variable = { which = pe_c7_cash value = pe_tmp }
			add_resource = { trade = 1 mult = pe_tmp }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_on value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_c8_sv value > 0 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { is_variable_set = pe_c8_prod } } if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_grp value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = pe_c8_prod value = 1 } } else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_grp value = 2 } } set_variable = { which = pe_c8_prod value = 3 } } else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_grp value = 3 } } set_variable = { which = pe_c8_prod value = 4 } } else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_grp value = 4 } } set_variable = { which = pe_c8_prod value = 8 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_prod value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_c8_sv } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 } every_owned_colony = { limit = { has_planet_flag = pe_hq_8 } change_variable = { which = pe_cpv_alloys value = root.pe_tmp } } set_variable = { which = pe_c8_out value = pe_tmp } round_variable = pe_c8_out }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_prod value = 2 } } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_c8_sv } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 } every_owned_colony = { limit = { has_planet_flag = pe_hq_8 } change_variable = { which = pe_cpv_consumer_goods value = root.pe_tmp } } set_variable = { which = pe_c8_out value = pe_tmp } round_variable = pe_c8_out }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_prod value = 3 } } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_c8_sv } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 2 } every_owned_colony = { limit = { has_planet_flag = pe_hq_8 } change_variable = { which = pe_cpv_trade value = root.pe_tmp } } set_variable = { which = pe_c8_out value = pe_tmp } round_variable = pe_c8_out }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_prod value = 4 } } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_c8_sv } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5714 } every_owned_colony = { limit = { has_planet_flag = pe_hq_8 } change_variable = { which = pe_cpv_physics_research value = root.pe_tmp } } set_variable = { which = pe_c8_out value = pe_tmp } round_variable = pe_c8_out }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_prod value = 5 } } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_c8_sv } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5714 } every_owned_colony = { limit = { has_planet_flag = pe_hq_8 } change_variable = { which = pe_cpv_society_research value = root.pe_tmp } } set_variable = { which = pe_c8_out value = pe_tmp } round_variable = pe_c8_out }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_prod value = 6 } } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_c8_sv } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5714 } every_owned_colony = { limit = { has_planet_flag = pe_hq_8 } change_variable = { which = pe_cpv_engineering_research value = root.pe_tmp } } set_variable = { which = pe_c8_out value = pe_tmp } round_variable = pe_c8_out }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_prod value = 7 } } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_c8_sv } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.6667 } every_owned_colony = { limit = { has_planet_flag = pe_hq_8 } change_variable = { which = pe_cpv_unity value = root.pe_tmp } } set_variable = { which = pe_c8_out value = pe_tmp } round_variable = pe_c8_out }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_prod value = 8 } } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_c8_sv } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 2 } every_owned_colony = { limit = { has_planet_flag = pe_hq_8 } change_variable = { which = pe_cpv_minerals value = root.pe_tmp } } set_variable = { which = pe_c8_out value = pe_tmp } round_variable = pe_c8_out }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_prod value = 9 } } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_c8_sv } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 2 } every_owned_colony = { limit = { has_planet_flag = pe_hq_8 } change_variable = { which = pe_cpv_energy value = root.pe_tmp } } set_variable = { which = pe_c8_out value = pe_tmp } round_variable = pe_c8_out }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_prod value = 10 } } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_c8_sv } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 2 } every_owned_colony = { limit = { has_planet_flag = pe_hq_8 } change_variable = { which = pe_cpv_food value = root.pe_tmp } } set_variable = { which = pe_c8_out value = pe_tmp } round_variable = pe_c8_out }
		set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_c8_sv }
		multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1.5 }
		change_variable = { which = pe_c8_cash value = pe_tmp }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_c8_shv value > 0 } }
			set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_c8_shv }
			multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.15 }
			subtract_variable = { which = pe_c8_cash value = pe_tmp }
			add_resource = { trade = 1 mult = pe_tmp }
		}
	}
	every_owned_colony = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_cpv_alloys value > 0 } has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_alloys check_variable = { which = pe_cpv_consumer_goods value > 0 } has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_consumer_goods check_variable = { which = pe_cpv_trade value > 0 } has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_trade check_variable = { which = pe_cpv_physics_research value > 0 } has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_physics_research check_variable = { which = pe_cpv_society_research value > 0 } has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_society_research check_variable = { which = pe_cpv_engineering_research value > 0 } has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_engineering_research check_variable = { which = pe_cpv_unity value > 0 } has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_unity check_variable = { which = pe_cpv_minerals value > 0 } has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_minerals check_variable = { which = pe_cpv_energy value > 0 } has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_energy check_variable = { which = pe_cpv_food value > 0 } has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_food } }
		root = { set_variable = { which = pe_lv value = prev.pe_cpv_alloys } }
		pe_ledger_bits = { V = cp_alloys }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cpv_alloys value >= 0.5 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_alloys } } add_deposit = d_pe_cprod_alloys }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_alloys } remove_deposit = d_pe_cprod_alloys }
		root = { set_variable = { which = pe_lv value = prev.pe_cpv_consumer_goods } }
		pe_ledger_bits = { V = cp_consumer_goods }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cpv_consumer_goods value >= 0.5 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_consumer_goods } } add_deposit = d_pe_cprod_consumer_goods }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_consumer_goods } remove_deposit = d_pe_cprod_consumer_goods }
		root = { set_variable = { which = pe_lv value = prev.pe_cpv_trade } }
		pe_ledger_bits = { V = cp_trade }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cpv_trade value >= 0.5 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_trade } } add_deposit = d_pe_cprod_trade }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_trade } remove_deposit = d_pe_cprod_trade }
		root = { set_variable = { which = pe_lv value = prev.pe_cpv_physics_research } }
		pe_ledger_bits = { V = cp_physics_research }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cpv_physics_research value >= 0.5 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_physics_research } } add_deposit = d_pe_cprod_physics_research }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_physics_research } remove_deposit = d_pe_cprod_physics_research }
		root = { set_variable = { which = pe_lv value = prev.pe_cpv_society_research } }
		pe_ledger_bits = { V = cp_society_research }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cpv_society_research value >= 0.5 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_society_research } } add_deposit = d_pe_cprod_society_research }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_society_research } remove_deposit = d_pe_cprod_society_research }
		root = { set_variable = { which = pe_lv value = prev.pe_cpv_engineering_research } }
		pe_ledger_bits = { V = cp_engineering_research }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cpv_engineering_research value >= 0.5 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_engineering_research } } add_deposit = d_pe_cprod_engineering_research }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_engineering_research } remove_deposit = d_pe_cprod_engineering_research }
		root = { set_variable = { which = pe_lv value = prev.pe_cpv_unity } }
		pe_ledger_bits = { V = cp_unity }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cpv_unity value >= 0.5 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_unity } } add_deposit = d_pe_cprod_unity }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_unity } remove_deposit = d_pe_cprod_unity }
		root = { set_variable = { which = pe_lv value = prev.pe_cpv_minerals } }
		pe_ledger_bits = { V = cp_minerals }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cpv_minerals value >= 0.5 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_minerals } } add_deposit = d_pe_cprod_minerals }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_minerals } remove_deposit = d_pe_cprod_minerals }
		root = { set_variable = { which = pe_lv value = prev.pe_cpv_energy } }
		pe_ledger_bits = { V = cp_energy }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cpv_energy value >= 0.5 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_energy } } add_deposit = d_pe_cprod_energy }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_energy } remove_deposit = d_pe_cprod_energy }
		root = { set_variable = { which = pe_lv value = prev.pe_cpv_food } }
		pe_ledger_bits = { V = cp_food }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cpv_food value >= 0.5 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_food } } add_deposit = d_pe_cprod_food }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { has_deposit = d_pe_cprod_food } remove_deposit = d_pe_cprod_food }
	}
}

# Country scope, once a year: what is left in the holdings' stores (stations whose
# corporation is gone, outside our borders ...). Short of it ourselves, we are offered it at
# 60% of the market price (pe.281); otherwise it is exported, and the investor pool gets half
# its base value.
pe_holdings_surplus = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = event_target:pe_hold }
		set_variable = { which = pe_hsx value = 0 }
		event_target:pe_hold = { export_resource_stockpile_to_variable = { resource = minerals variable = pe_hs } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_hs value = prev.pe_hs } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_hs value >= 100 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_def_minerals value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_hsx value = 0 } is_ai = no }
				set_variable = { which = pe_hsx value = 1 }
				set_variable = { which = pe_hs_amt value = pe_hs }
				round_variable = pe_hs_amt
				export_trigger_value_to_variable = { trigger = market_resource_price parameters = { resource = minerals amount = 100 trade_type = market_buy } variable = pe_hs_price }
				divide_variable = { which = pe_hs_price value = 100 }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_hs_price value <= 0 } } set_variable = { which = pe_hs_price value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_hs_cost value = pe_hs_amt }
				multiply_variable = { which = pe_hs_cost value = pe_hs_price }
				multiply_variable = { which = pe_hs_cost value = 0.6 }
				round_variable = pe_hs_cost
				country_event = { id = pe.281 }
			}
			else = {
				event_target:pe_hold = { add_resource = { minerals = -1 mult = root.pe_hs } }
				multiply_variable = { which = pe_hs value = 0.5 }
				change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = pe_hs }
			}
		}
		event_target:pe_hold = { export_resource_stockpile_to_variable = { resource = energy variable = pe_hs } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_hs value = prev.pe_hs } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_hs value >= 100 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_def_energy value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_hsx value = 0 } is_ai = no }
				set_variable = { which = pe_hsx value = 2 }
				set_variable = { which = pe_hs_amt value = pe_hs }
				round_variable = pe_hs_amt
				export_trigger_value_to_variable = { trigger = market_resource_price parameters = { resource = energy amount = 100 trade_type = market_buy } variable = pe_hs_price }
				divide_variable = { which = pe_hs_price value = 100 }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_hs_price value <= 0 } } set_variable = { which = pe_hs_price value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_hs_cost value = pe_hs_amt }
				multiply_variable = { which = pe_hs_cost value = pe_hs_price }
				multiply_variable = { which = pe_hs_cost value = 0.6 }
				round_variable = pe_hs_cost
				country_event = { id = pe.281 }
			}
			else = {
				event_target:pe_hold = { add_resource = { energy = -1 mult = root.pe_hs } }
				multiply_variable = { which = pe_hs value = 0.5 }
				change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = pe_hs }
			}
		}
		event_target:pe_hold = { export_resource_stockpile_to_variable = { resource = food variable = pe_hs } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_hs value = prev.pe_hs } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_hs value >= 100 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_def_food value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_hsx value = 0 } is_ai = no }
				set_variable = { which = pe_hsx value = 3 }
				set_variable = { which = pe_hs_amt value = pe_hs }
				round_variable = pe_hs_amt
				export_trigger_value_to_variable = { trigger = market_resource_price parameters = { resource = food amount = 100 trade_type = market_buy } variable = pe_hs_price }
				divide_variable = { which = pe_hs_price value = 100 }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_hs_price value <= 0 } } set_variable = { which = pe_hs_price value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_hs_cost value = pe_hs_amt }
				multiply_variable = { which = pe_hs_cost value = pe_hs_price }
				multiply_variable = { which = pe_hs_cost value = 0.6 }
				round_variable = pe_hs_cost
				country_event = { id = pe.281 }
			}
			else = {
				event_target:pe_hold = { add_resource = { food = -1 mult = root.pe_hs } }
				multiply_variable = { which = pe_hs value = 0.5 }
				change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = pe_hs }
			}
		}
		event_target:pe_hold = { export_resource_stockpile_to_variable = { resource = trade variable = pe_hs } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_hs value = prev.pe_hs } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_hs value >= 100 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_def_trade value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_hsx value = 0 } is_ai = no }
				set_variable = { which = pe_hsx value = 4 }
				set_variable = { which = pe_hs_amt value = pe_hs }
				round_variable = pe_hs_amt
				export_trigger_value_to_variable = { trigger = market_resource_price parameters = { resource = trade amount = 100 trade_type = market_buy } variable = pe_hs_price }
				divide_variable = { which = pe_hs_price value = 100 }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_hs_price value <= 0 } } set_variable = { which = pe_hs_price value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_hs_cost value = pe_hs_amt }
				multiply_variable = { which = pe_hs_cost value = pe_hs_price }
				multiply_variable = { which = pe_hs_cost value = 0.6 }
				round_variable = pe_hs_cost
				country_event = { id = pe.281 }
			}
			else = {
				event_target:pe_hold = { add_resource = { trade = -1 mult = root.pe_hs } }
				multiply_variable = { which = pe_hs value = 0.5 }
				change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = pe_hs }
			}
		}
		event_target:pe_hold = { export_resource_stockpile_to_variable = { resource = alloys variable = pe_hs } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_hs value = prev.pe_hs } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_hs value >= 100 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_def_alloys value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_hsx value = 0 } is_ai = no }
				set_variable = { which = pe_hsx value = 5 }
				set_variable = { which = pe_hs_amt value = pe_hs }
				round_variable = pe_hs_amt
				export_trigger_value_to_variable = { trigger = market_resource_price parameters = { resource = alloys amount = 100 trade_type = market_buy } variable = pe_hs_price }
				divide_variable = { which = pe_hs_price value = 100 }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_hs_price value <= 0 } } set_variable = { which = pe_hs_price value = 4 } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_hs_cost value = pe_hs_amt }
				multiply_variable = { which = pe_hs_cost value = pe_hs_price }
				multiply_variable = { which = pe_hs_cost value = 0.6 }
				round_variable = pe_hs_cost
				country_event = { id = pe.281 }
			}
			else = {
				event_target:pe_hold = { add_resource = { alloys = -1 mult = root.pe_hs } }
				multiply_variable = { which = pe_hs value = 2 }
				change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = pe_hs }
			}
		}
		event_target:pe_hold = { export_resource_stockpile_to_variable = { resource = consumer_goods variable = pe_hs } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_hs value = prev.pe_hs } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_hs value >= 100 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_def_consumer_goods value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_hsx value = 0 } is_ai = no }
				set_variable = { which = pe_hsx value = 6 }
				set_variable = { which = pe_hs_amt value = pe_hs }
				round_variable = pe_hs_amt
				export_trigger_value_to_variable = { trigger = market_resource_price parameters = { resource = consumer_goods amount = 100 trade_type = market_buy } variable = pe_hs_price }
				divide_variable = { which = pe_hs_price value = 100 }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_hs_price value <= 0 } } set_variable = { which = pe_hs_price value = 2 } }
				set_variable = { which = pe_hs_cost value = pe_hs_amt }
				multiply_variable = { which = pe_hs_cost value = pe_hs_price }
				multiply_variable = { which = pe_hs_cost value = 0.6 }
				round_variable = pe_hs_cost
				country_event = { id = pe.281 }
			}
			else = {
				event_target:pe_hold = { add_resource = { consumer_goods = -1 mult = root.pe_hs } }
				multiply_variable = { which = pe_hs value = 1 }
				change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = pe_hs }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (event pe.281): buy the holdings' stock of resource pe_hsx.
pe_holdings_sell = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_hsx value = 1 } } add_resource = { minerals = 1 mult = pe_hs_amt } event_target:pe_hold = { add_resource = { minerals = -1 mult = root.pe_hs_amt } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_hsx value = 2 } } add_resource = { energy = 1 mult = pe_hs_amt } event_target:pe_hold = { add_resource = { energy = -1 mult = root.pe_hs_amt } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_hsx value = 3 } } add_resource = { food = 1 mult = pe_hs_amt } event_target:pe_hold = { add_resource = { food = -1 mult = root.pe_hs_amt } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_hsx value = 4 } } add_resource = { trade = 1 mult = pe_hs_amt } event_target:pe_hold = { add_resource = { trade = -1 mult = root.pe_hs_amt } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_hsx value = 5 } } add_resource = { alloys = 1 mult = pe_hs_amt } event_target:pe_hold = { add_resource = { alloys = -1 mult = root.pe_hs_amt } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_hsx value = 6 } } add_resource = { consumer_goods = 1 mult = pe_hs_amt } event_target:pe_hold = { add_resource = { consumer_goods = -1 mult = root.pe_hs_amt } } }
	add_resource = { trade = -1 mult = pe_hs_cost }
	change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = pe_hs_cost }
}
